citations.claim: Fault: the trust bootstrap forced project settings to trusted before reloading settings and resolving extensions, so a previously-trusted state let project-local extensions load before trust was decided.

Fix: loadProjectTrustExtensions now calls settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(false) before settingsManager.reload(), so the untrusted setting is in force for the bootstrap resolve; user/global and temporary CLI extensions still load.
reload() runs the bootstrap pass via loadProjectTrustExtensions before the trust resolver, then applies the resolved value for the final extension set.

Regression exercises the real DefaultResourceLoader through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createTrustSubject; assertUntrustedBootstrap encodes the invariant that no trusted state exists before the first extension resolve, and the four scenarios cover trusted-start, denied, untrusted-start, and direct bootstrap entry points.

validation.notes: Root cause: DefaultResourceLoader.loadProjectTrustExtensions (packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:435) called setProjectTrusted(true) and then settingsManager.reload(), contradicting its own comment. When the previous SettingsManager state was trusted, the bootstrap pass reloaded settings as trusted and resolved project-scoped extensions/packages, so project code loaded before the resolveProjectTrust decision. Fix: one-line change to setProjectTrusted(false) before settingsManager.reload() (line 438); nothing else altered, so the post-decision setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted) at line 454 still enables project extensions once trust is granted. Validation ran from the workspace root against the fixed source with no dependencies or network: 4 scenarios pass (exit 0). Shared invariant (assertUntrustedBootstrap, regression.mjs:33): before the first package resolve no setProjectTrusted(true) or trusted settings reload may occur, the first resolve must observe untrusted, and the first loadExtensionsCached batch must be exactly [cli.ts, user.ts] with no project.ts. Scenarios: (1) previous state trusted + reload({resolveProjectTrust: approve}) - invariant holds, the extensionsResult handed to the trust resolver is user/global + CLI only, final getExtensions() is [cli.ts, project.ts, user.ts], and the last applied setting is trusted=true; (2) trust denied - invariant holds, every resolve is untrusted, project.ts is never loaded and the final set is [cli.ts, user.ts]; (3) previous state untrusted - identical untrusted bootstrap, project extensions load after approval; (4) direct loadProjectTrustExtensions() with a trusted prior state (the CLI trust-prompt path) - invariant holds and the returned set is [cli.ts, user.ts]. Fault sensitivity verified by temporarily restoring setProjectTrusted(true): the run failed with AssertionError 'trusted-start reload: bootstrap must force untrusted settings before resolving extensions, saw setProjectTrusted([true])' (exit 1); the fixed line was then restored (git diff shows only the single-line production change). Limitation: the repository vitest suites (e.g. packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts) could not be executed because node_modules is not installed and dependency installation/network use is out of scope, so this VM-module regression plus manual review of the unchanged post-trust path stood in for them.
